calculation.description: Ranks lagged VIX shock and cross-asset return dispersion over a 120-day window, multiplies the bounded regime intensity by the negative 3-day return, and median-centers cross-sectionally. All inputs are lagged or completed-day data.

metrics.library_correlation_audit: scripts/miner_2_20270225_continuous_regime_audit.py; aligned artifact Pearson against vix_shock factor; n=3715

validation.regime_notes: 1-day IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (0.01794), 2023-2024 (0.01664), 2025-2026 (0.06794), and 2027 through validation date (0.01971). Conditional intensity is deliberately continuous rather than sparse; small cross-sectional universe implies uncertainty. Deterministic audit found high overlap: max Pearson correlation 0.94978 with existing VIX-shock reversal; retained in quarantine and not added as a distinct library factor.
